Gyrocopter: A Support or a Carry?

He can be played as both with his heavy magic damage and aoe attacks.

However I would argue he is much stronger as a (semi) carry than a support. His Q allows him to get a quick first blood and make sure no one is getting close to him without taking heavy damage. He can solo his lane really well against most offlaners which allow the supports to help the other lanes/stack for him.

He got a kit for quick farming and early teamfights. I would compare him to luna. They're both able to flash farm, they got lots of nuking potiental and both of them relies on bkb (bkb btw wasn't nerfed. It got an extra second on the last use. It's only nerfed in the regard that you can't get a new one which rarely happened any way.).

There are several problems with running him as a support.

  1. He needs to get close with his Q. If he doesn't have the sufficient items it can prove fatal for him.

  2. His W, the rocket, is not a reliable stun at all. Even though the damage is incredible good he needs some supporting cc to get it off.

  3. Without any items putting points in his E seems like a waste.

These are my immediate thoughts on Gyro.
